title: anthyllis vulneraria var. arenaria
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria var. arenaria, commonly known as kidney vetch, is a perennial plant species belonging to the pea family. It is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to help reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections due to its diuretic and astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of kidney vetch include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may also contribute to its antimicrobial and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
